dependency_discipline.literal_input: consume one complete alpha from the exact frozen C1-U correspondence, including its type-by-identity payoffs, H payoffs, strategies, beliefs, payments, continuation selections, and type-conditional outcome kernels
dependency_discipline.cost_application_count_if_formation: one subtraction of chi from each weak identity after C1 is computed
dependency_discipline.mutation_rule: any byte change to Gate 0, the R1 batch freeze, or C1-U invalidates this candidate and every descendant

validated_domain_gate.validated_common_existence_domain: every primitive-admissible N>=3 case exported by frozen C1-U
validated_domain_gate.consumer_rule: the candidate is consumable only after independent PASS of this exact hash

formation_primitive.timing: Nature draws theta, then the uninformed weak coalition makes one collective all-or-nothing decision, then Round-1 recognition occurs if and only if it forms
formation_primitive.information: the weak coalition knows mu and the complete equilibrium assessment alpha but does not observe theta
formation_primitive.cost: each of the m weak states pays the same external sunk cost chi if formation occurs; chi never reduces the unit bargaining pie and never changes C1
formation_primitive.nonformation: each weak state receives zero, H type theta receives o_theta, and the terminal outcome is nonformation
formation_primitive.equality: formation occurs when the collective net value is exactly zero
formation_primitive.individual_participation_warning: the collective primitive does not require every weak identity or every realized type to have a nonnegative net payoff under an asymmetric alpha

required_assessment_payload.assessment_index: alpha is the complete frozen C1-U selection and must remain attached to every entry output
required_assessment_payload.within_recognizer_input: for each recognized weak proposer i, E_sigma_i[U_Wk^i(theta;alpha_i)] for every weak identity k and theta, plus the aligned H coordinate and outcome kernel
required_assessment_payload.c1_weak_matrix: C1_W_alpha[theta,k]=(1/m) sum_i E_sigma_i[U_Wk^i(theta;alpha_i)], a 2 by m matrix
required_assessment_payload.c1_outcome_kernel: D1_alpha(theta) integrates the same alpha first over sigma_i and then over uniform recognition, separately by theta
required_assessment_payload.alignment: payoffs and outcome kernels must use the same sigma, recognition weights, beliefs, strategies, payments, and continuation selections; coordinate splicing is forbidden

integration_operator.step_1: inside each recognizer i and each theta, integrate U^i(theta;s,alpha_i) and its aligned outcome kernel over sigma_i
integration_operator.step_2: for each theta and player identity, average the Step-1 coordinates over the m uniformly recognized weak proposers to obtain C1_W_alpha[theta,k], C1_H_alpha[theta], and D1_alpha(theta)
integration_operator.step_3: retain both theta rows and every weak identity; define T_W_alpha(theta)=sum_k C1_W_alpha[theta,k]
integration_operator.step_4: only now integrate type using the public prior: G_U(alpha,mu)=((1-mu)T_W_alpha(0)+mu T_W_alpha(1))/m
integration_operator.step_5: define the collective net formation value Z_U(alpha,mu,chi)=G_U(alpha,mu)-chi
forbidden_orders: replacing the identity vector by a scalar before C1 is constructed
selecting different alpha coordinates for different types, identities, payoffs, or outcomes
conditioning recognition on theta or proposal outcomes
subtracting chi before bargaining or from the unit pie
multiplying any C1 coordinate by beta again

assessment_level_output.status_label: form when e_U=1 and no_form when e_U=0
assessment_level_output.alpha_retention: two alphas remain distinct even if gross values, net values, or status labels coincide

realized_payoff_and_outcome_map.if_form_outcome: D_entry_alpha(theta)=D1_alpha(theta), with an external cost overlay of chi for every weak identity
realized_payoff_and_outcome_map.if_no_form_weak: u_entry_Wk(theta;alpha)=0 for every k and theta
realized_payoff_and_outcome_map.type_independence_of_action: because theta is unobserved, the same e_U applies to both type rows

exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.source_set: A_U(P) is the nonempty full C1-U assessment correspondence for primitives and public history P on the validated N>=3 domain
exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.entry_map: Entry_U(alpha,mu,chi) is the complete alpha-preserving record of G_U, Z_U, e_U, the type-by-identity realized payoff map, H payoffs, and aligned outcome kernels
exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.status_projection: S_U(P,mu,chi)={form: some alpha has G_U>=chi} union {no_form: some alpha has G_U<chi}
exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.nonemptiness: proved from frozen universal C1-U existence for every primitive-admissible N>=3 case
exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.preservation_rule: E_U is not quotiented by its scalar gross-value image or status projection; alpha, identity payoffs, H coordinates, and outcomes remain in every element
exact_set_valued_entry_correspondence.selection_status: exact and set-valued; no entry selection is added

endpoint_interface.existence: both finite endpoints exist because Gset_U is nonempty and bounded in [0,1/m]
endpoint_interface.lower_attainment_indicator: a_U_minus=1 iff some alpha has G_U(alpha,mu)=L_U; no general N=3 truth value is supplied
endpoint_interface.upper_attainment_indicator: a_U_plus=1 iff some alpha has G_U(alpha,mu)=U_U; no general truth value is supplied
endpoint_interface.no_compactness_assumption: the frozen C1 correspondence can inherit nonclosed continuation boundaries, so endpoint attainment is never inferred from boundedness
endpoint_interface.proved_special_attainment: for every N>=4, the frozen universal zero-weak-value C1-U assessment proves L_U=0 and a_U_minus=1
endpoint_interface.N3_attainment_status: parameter- and correspondence-dependent; pending any sharper result and not defaulted
endpoint_interface.upper_attainment_status: parameter- and correspondence-dependent for every N>=3; not defaulted
endpoint_interface.closed_form_value_status: not supplied by the frozen interface in general; consumers requiring numeric endpoints must solve the full C1 image rather than insert a bound or choose alpha

selection_free_formation_logic.possible_form: some alpha forms iff chi<U_U, or chi=U_U and a_U_plus=1
selection_free_formation_logic.possible_no_form: some alpha does not form iff L_U<chi
selection_free_formation_logic.all_no_form: every alpha does not form iff U_U<chi, or chi=U_U and a_U_plus=0
selection_free_formation_logic.lower_equality: at chi=L_U every alpha forms whether or not L_U is attained
selection_free_formation_logic.upper_equality: at chi=U_U, formation is possible exactly when the supremum is attained; if it is unattained, every alpha has G_U<chi and all do not form
selection_free_formation_logic.singleton_check: if L_U=U_U=chi, bounded nonemptiness implies both endpoints are attained, every alpha forms, and no alpha chooses no formation

selection_free_bounds.frozen_c1_input: for every alpha and theta, 0<=C1_W_alpha[theta,k] and 0<=T_W_alpha(theta)<=1
selection_free_bounds.cost_zero: chi=0 implies all_form for every N>=3, including equality at zero
selection_free_bounds.cost_above_upper_bound: chi>1/m implies all_no_form for every N>=3
selection_free_bounds.cost_at_upper_bound: at chi=1/m, possible_form requires an alpha attaining G_U=1/m; otherwise all_no_form
selection_free_bounds.interior_cost: for 0<chi<1/m, the coarse C1 bounds alone do not select or classify all assessments
selection_free_bounds.Nge4_zero_assessment: for every N>=4 and chi>0, the attained zero-weak-value alpha proves possible_no_form and rules out all_form
selection_free_bounds.N3_warning: no zero-value assessment is asserted from the general N=3 C1 export
selection_free_bounds.individual_warning: formation based on the collective average does not imply nonnegative type-by-identity realized net payoffs

sufficient_for: realized type-by-identity weak and H payoff maps
the stated coarse bounds and N>=4 lower-endpoint result
input_sufficiency_and_stop_rule.not_sufficient_for: a general closed-form numerical formula for L_U, U_U, or upper-endpoint attainment
input_sufficiency_and_stop_rule.decision: no upstream reopen is needed for the exact entry correspondence; no unavailable closed-form endpoint is claimed
input_sufficiency_and_stop_rule.mandatory_reopen: reopen or further solve frozen C1-U before any consumer reports numeric endpoint functions, treats [0,1/m] as the attained value set, or chooses alpha using a bound

mechanical_checks.scope: exact dependency hashes, synthetic full-vector assessment fixtures, sigma-recognition-type-average order, identity asymmetry, aligned outcomes, external cost accounting, equality formation, nonformation, exact finite-correspondence preservation, symbolic endpoint/nonattainment logic, boundaries, mutations, and protected hashes

invalidation: any change to the exact Gate 0, R1 batch, or C1-U bytes; to collective all-or-nothing entry; to type information; to external per-weak cost; to equality formation; or to the aligned alpha payload reopens this node and every descendant
artifact_hash_protocol: SHA-256 is computed externally over exact UTF-8 bytes; the digest is not stored recursively inside this candidate
